assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production walking sprite sheet for an original top-down woodland pixel-art game. The supplied image is the EXACT APPROVED NPC identity: preserve its face, age, skin color, hair, ears, crooked pointed hat, distinctive colors, clothes, footwear and accessories. No tears or sad expressions: friendly mischievous everyday neighbor. Do NOT redesign into a generic green elf or the orange-hatted hero. Make crisp detailed warm pixel-art sprites with well-defined readable color clusters at 80px final character height. Fixed RPG camera tilted down 35degrees: see hat crown, shoulders and tops of boots. EXACT GRID: 8 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS, 32 full-body poses, landscape 2048x1024, cells256x256. All full figures fit separately within their cells with clean empty gutters, same physical scale. Eight columns LEFT TO RIGHT: SOUTH (straight toward viewer, symmetric frontal face and torso), SOUTH-EAST (face and torso turn toward lower-right), EAST (right-side profile), NORTH-EAST (back and right side, facing upper-right), NORTH (fully back, no face), NORTH-WEST (back and left side toward upper-left), WEST (left-side profile), SOUTH-WEST (front and left side toward lower-left). Every row keeps this same direction order. ROW1 neutral standing, arms relaxed; ROW2 left leg forward, opposite arm forward, right leg back; ROW3 passing step, one boot beneath body, other heel lifted; ROW4 right leg forward, opposite arm forward, left leg back. Real articulated legs and opposing arm swings, distinct boots, not a translated still image. Same head/body size across all poses. Each cell: foot-contact baseline at y235, sprite top around y24, horizontal root at x128. Hands and ears fully inside cell. Clear hat, face, hands and boots, no extra objects, no scenery, no grid marks, no text or labels, no cast shadows. Genuinely transparent alpha preferred; otherwise a perfectly SOLID #FF00FF magenta chromakey background. Absolutely no checkerboard, no dark gradient, no glow.
